node.statement: Taking anti-Hermitian parts gives -A=B+P^par((B+G(B)) bold-dot Q). Thus ||B||<=r+(1+epsilon_r)*(1+d)*||B||*||Q||. The fixed polar-normal bound and a universal cutoff make (1+epsilon_r)*(1+d)*||Q||<=1/2, so ||B||<=2r; therefore the sharp graph derivative estimate from node 1.3 applies at both A and B.
